thread:
maria: Quick async check — can folks drop short updates for the milestone bundle we're tracking (Autoscaler rollout, runtime canary, cost-control feature flags). Format: shipped / slipped / blocker / next action + owner. No long threads, just one-liners.

devon: Autoscaler: shipped to staging, smoke looks good. Targeting prod canary tomorrow morning. Owner: devon. Next: smoke + perf run. NO blockers. :thumbsup:

olivia: Runtime canary: partial slip — model-startup regressions popped on long seqs. Owner: olivia. Ship status: slipped to EOD Thu. Blocker: investigating kernel scheduling quirk; need SRE trace. @ops-bot can you attach last 2 deploy traces?

ops-bot: ops-bot: Deploy traces attached: deploy-2026-03-02.log, trace-id: 9f2a7c. Payload shows elevated stall at step:kv-cache-warmup. (automated)

sam: Cost-control flags: feature flags merged, rollout in prod gated by runtime canary passing. Owner: sam. Shipped to canary flags on dev-only cluster. Next: enable on canary when runtime passes. No infra blockers.

maria: Noted Olivia + Ops. Devon — if autoscaler perf run hits <50ms p99, merch wants to flip canary early. Keep us posted.

devon: Will run perf at 06:30 PT tomorrow and post results. If p99 < 60ms we can do a small canary (10%). Otherwise hold.

jin: Heads-up: QA found a prompt-escape regression in cost-control when TTL caching enabled. Owner: jin. Status: investigating; might be config mismatch. Slip risk: low, might be hotfix today.

olivia: Update: traced the kernel scheduling — repro on g5x nodes with long sequences + batch scheduling. Working on workaround: pin to legacy scheduler for canary nodes. ETA 4h. Blocker -> ops tracing + permission to rotate canary nodes.

maria: Action items: (1) @ops-bot confirm permission to rotate canary nodes for olivia; (2) @devon post perf numbers tomorrow; (3) @jin estimate hotfix ETA after triage; (4) @sam hold production flag until runtime canary green. If any owner needs a quick huddle, react with :phone: and I'll set a 15m.

devon: Perf run scheduled, will paste numbers in this thread.

jin: Quick note — reproducer snippet I used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.test/generate -d '{"prompt": "<long input>", "ttl_cache": true}'
```
Seeing escape when combined with partial-token caching. Sharing logs now.

sam: A few customers asked about timing for cost flags; I've communicated tentative hold until canary is green. I'll update docs once sam gets final go.

olivia: Ops approved rotate for canary nodes. Kicking rotation now, will report when nodes back. :rocket:

ops-bot: ops-bot: Rotation started for canary-nodes-03. Estimated 7m. (automated)

maria: Great — thanks everyone. We'll reconvene async here. If anything critical changes, ping #eng-oncall and add :page_facing_up: with a short note.
